//: Deliberately NOT present: a catch-all rewrite to index.html.
That pattern is for single-page apps on static hosts, where a refresh on
/some/route 404s because no such file exists. Next.js App Router
prerenders every route to its own document, so refresh already works.
Adding the rewrite here would shadow the real routes and break the 404
Build/install commands and the output directory are left to Vercel's
Next.js preset — overriding them only creates ways for the deploy to fail.
Set the project's Root Directory to `client` in the Vercel dashboard.
